newsitem.title: USA: Corrections Corp to manage 250-bed prison.
newsitem.headline: Corrections Corp to manage 250-bed prison.

text.p: Corrections Corp. of America said on Tuesday it had reached an agreement to refinance and manage a 250-bed Minnesota correction facility, for an expected $19.5 million increase in annual revenues.
Corrections Corp, which manages jails and prisons for government agencies, said in a statement it would expand the Prairie Correction Facility in Appleton, Minn. to 512 beds.

It said it would pay $22.5 million to retire all the existing debt on the facilty and will fund the $15 million needed for its expansion. The investment would be repaid over a 20-year term at 9.25 percent interest, the company said.
The company said it would assume management on October 1 and begin construction of the additional cells immediately. The expansion should be complete in the second quarter of 1997, it said.
The company has a total of 37,111 beds in 54 facilities under contract in 15 U.S. states, Puerto Rico, Australia and the United Kingdom.
